name: dryrun_01_marrakesh_pipeline_check
notes: Pre-registration Q1 v0.4, Section 6 (Minute budget): 'Pipeline checks (transpilation, job submission, logging, result parsing) therefore run on ibm_marrakesh under the open plan at no Flex cost'; also Paper 2 pre-registration Gate P2-1 (c): 'The Marrakesh dry run completes end to end, every row parses, and reset survives transpilation as a distinct instruction' and Section 3b kill rule (c) (a measure count above the terminal readout means reset was compiled to measure-plus-conditional-X). Smallest end-to-end run of the Paper 1 pipeline: one 1x10 path (n = 10), L = 2, k = 1, M = 5 draws, 1024 shots, resilience 0 and 1 (two Estimator jobs), plus two probe jobs: a shifted pair with a mid-circuit native reset after each layer (p = 0.5, one mask) and its delay(400 ns)-matched control. Layout: ibm_marrakesh is heavy-hex (girth 12), so the 2x5 square patch cannot embed without routing; the 1x10 path is placed with the explicit `layout` [5..14] (row 0 of the heavy hex, lowest summed CZ + readout error on the FakeMarrakesh calibration; runner-up path 0-9), the Patch keeps lattice coordinates as a frame and the observable edge is 9_10 (locals 4_5). On FakeMarrakesh: depth 12, 18 CZ (= L x 9 path edges), no routing; dial variants depth 14, 18 CZ. THE LAYOUT MUST BE RE-CHECKED AGAINST THE LIVE ibm_marrakesh CALIBRATION AT PRE-FLIGHT (swap to 0-9 if a qubit or coupler on 5-14 is out or above the readout cut). The per-job bundle records the ISA instruction names, the measure count, the reset/delay counts and the target durations (circuits.json) and backend.default_rep_delay / rep_delay_range and the verified instance plan (job.json). Target at most 3 open-plan minutes (estimate in budget). Nothing is submitted while dry_run is true and the pre-flight review permalink is TBD.

probes.purpose: what the transpiler emits for a mid-circuit native reset (ISA name, measure count, scheduled duration)
same mask with delay(400 ns) in place of reset: what the transpiler emits for the delay (dt units, duration)

budget.formula: 2 s per job + (rep_delay + L x 0.71 us + 1.94 us readout [+ dial durations]) x executions
